verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own bill-payment approval workflow: invoices are routed for approval and paid with "7x fewer clicks", dynamic approval routing supports parallel workflows, and bills can be approved through the UI, the Approvals API or the CLI. However, the evidence never shows a finance lead configuring approval permissions for named teammates, or a one-click approve-and-send-payment action. missing for 10: documented setup of approver permissions/roles for designated teammates, explicit one-click approve-and-pay flow, independent hands-on corroboration of the bill approval experience.
